name: BACH_0188_FSIM_stain3
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (99%)** · Confident · Careful review

Single-class conformal set, but the second model disagrees and the image is stain-degraded.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 99%, Normal 1% | Very peaked |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.98 / 76th percentile | Input looks typical |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Disagrees on top class |
| Similar cases | 3 of 5 InSitu | Two Normal neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules** (regions 7, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Largest concept term; spot check 0/20 · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 0, 1, 10) · ↓ invasive · Associated with lower invasive likelihood [F3] · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 3, 5, 6) · ↓ invasive · Duct-confined atypia, associated with non-invasive disease · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 2, 3, 4) · ↑ invasive · Leans toward invasive in concept model; spot check 0/20 · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Beats random-region deletion (+0.54 logit, CI 0.47 to 0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (−0.005 to 0.007); not shown to reflect the classifier. Normal lobules and mitoses are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Stain degradation (severity 3) distorts features; MUSK picks a different top class.
- Two of five similar cases are Normal, including BACH_0062 (84% similar).

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 9:** highest per-region invasive risk (54%); look for infiltrating tumor in stroma.
2. **Regions 3, 5, 6:** confirm atypical cells remain confined within ducts.
3. **Regions 7, 10, 11:** verify lobules are truly normal; concept spot check failed.
